hook: The Department of Justice holds 6 million pages, but millions are missing.

sections.voiceover: The Department of Justice holds 6 million pages, but millions are missing.

sections.voiceover: Federal investigators collected 6 million pages related to Jeffrey Epstein. Officials released only 3 million pages after internal reviews. Why do 2,355,212 empty slots exist in the EFTA sequence, which tracks official document storage?

sections.voiceover: GitHub analysis shows these gaps hide information, as only 376,571 distinct documents actually exist.

sections.voiceover: The Office of the Deputy Attorney General received classified Jeffrey Epstein material in March 2025. Internal documents confirm the Department of Justice included three classified files, including an FBI document.
